questions.question: Which club became the first in Premier League history to win a match after trailing by three goals at half-time, coming back from 3–0 down to win 5–3 in September 2001?
questions.explanation: Tottenham Hotspur led 3–0 at the break before Manchester United produced a remarkable five-goal second-half response at White Hart Lane.
questions.anchorClues: Manchester United / Tottenham Hotspur vs Man Utd 2001

questions.question: True or False: Leicester City's 9–0 away victory over Southampton in October 2019 equalled the record for the biggest winning margin in Premier League history.
questions.explanation: Leicester City matched Manchester United's 9–0 win against Ipswich Town from 1995, setting a new record for the largest away victory in top-flight history.
questions.anchorClues: Southampton vs Leicester City 2019 / Premier League records

questions.question: In which season did Chelsea set the Premier League record for conceding the fewest goals across a single 38-game campaign, letting in just 15 goals?
questions.explanation: Under José Mourinho, Chelsea kept 25 clean sheets and conceded only 15 league goals on their way to winning the title with 95 points.

questions.question: Which Belgian playmaker recorded 20 Premier League assists during the 2019–20 season, equalling Thierry Henry's single-season record?
questions.explanation: Kevin De Bruyne reached 20 assists for Manchester City in 2019–20, matching the benchmark set by Thierry Henry for Arsenal in 2002–03.
questions.anchorClues: Kevin De Bruyne / Premier League assist record

questions.question: Which Italian manager guided Chelsea to their first Premier League title in five years during the 2009–10 season, with his side scoring a then-record 103 league goals?
questions.explanation: Carlo Ancelotti won the Premier League and FA Cup double in his debut season at Stamford Bridge, breaking the 100-goal barrier in the process.

questions.question: True or False: Arsenal went through the entire 2003–04 'Invincibles' season without suffering a single defeat in any domestic cup competition.
questions.explanation: While unbeaten across all 38 Premier League fixtures, Arsenal suffered domestic cup exits against Manchester United in the FA Cup semi-finals and Middlesbrough in the League Cup semi-finals.

questions.question: Which squad number was famously assigned to French central defender William Gallas upon his arrival at Arsenal in August 2006, despite normally being reserved for attacking playmakers?
questions.explanation: Arsène Wenger handed the number 10 shirt—vacated by the retiring Dennis Bergkamp—to defender William Gallas to relieve pressure on future attacking signings.

questions.question: Which Ivory Coast international scored 29 Premier League goals during Chelsea's 2009–10 title-winning season to claim his second Golden Boot?
questions.explanation: Didier Drogba scored a hat-trick on the final day against Wigan Athletic to reach 29 goals, edging past Wayne Rooney to claim the Golden Boot.
questions.anchorClues: Didier Drogba / Premier League Golden Boot 2009–10

questions.question: Which club defeated Manchester United 3–1 in April 1996 after forcing them to change their grey away kit at half-time, before beating them 6–3 at home six months later?
questions.explanation: Southampton famously defeated Alex Ferguson's side at The Dell twice in 1996, including the infamous grey-shirt swap match in April.

questions.question: Which Spanish midfielder is the only player in Premier League history to record four assists in a single match on two separate occasions, accomplishing the feat for two different London clubs?
questions.explanation: Cesc Fàbregas set up four goals for Arsenal against Blackburn Rovers in October 2009, and repeated the four-assist match for Chelsea against Bournemouth in April 2016.
questions.anchorClues: Cesc Fàbregas / Four assists single match
